description: This file defines memory-related functions and macros for the rt-loader component, including cache operations, memory management, and string/memory utilities.

methods.name: flush_cache
methods.description: Flushes the cache for a memory region starting at start_addr with size count.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Frees allocated memory pointed to by ptr.

methods.name: malloc
methods.description: Allocates a block of memory of size count.

methods.name: memcmp
methods.description: Compares two memory areas s1 and s2 for size count.

methods.name: memmove
methods.description: Moves memory from source to destination, handling overlapping regions.

methods.name: memcpy
methods.description: Copies memory from source to destination.

methods.name: memset
methods.description: Sets a block of memory to a specified byte value.

methods.name: strlen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string.

methods.name: crc32
methods.description: Computes the CRC32 checksum of a memory region.
